{"metadata":{"kernelspec":{"name":"python3","display_name":"Python 3","language":"python"},"language_info":{"name":"python"}},"nbformat_minor":4,"nbformat":4,"cells":[{"cell_type":"markdown","source":"# V81 — Harvest Ledger — Spatial Mirror Gate

V81 keeps the complete online-proven V79 policy and makes the sale horizon opponent-aware. It uses the seven-turn lead only when both public farms have the same coordinate-level crop, structure, animal, farmer, hand, and land fingerprint with a small cash gap; otherwise it preserves V79's four-turn horizon. No hidden information, opponent identity, replay fingerprint, or production parameter is used. This is the lower-risk option designed to target same-lineage market races without always selling early.

Final holdout versus V79: 30 games, mean paired delta +38.20 coins, median 0, worst -4; 8 better, 20 equal, 2 worse. These are local cash margins against frozen public families, not a Kaggle rating prediction. A separate second seed panel was also used during selection.

Direct public ancestry: https://www.kaggle.com/code/guruprasaathas111/kaggriculture-top-2-master-engine-v4. Full attribution is retained in `main.py` and `NOTICE.txt` under Apache-2.0 terms.

Run both code cells to create `submission.tar.gz` with `main.py`, `LICENSE.txt`, and `NOTICE.txt` at archive root. Standard-library CPU only; no network or GPU is required. The notebook contains no tests, replay data, credentials, or automatic submission code.

                member.mode = 0o644
                member.mtime = 0
                archive.addfile(member, io.BytesIO(content))

V81 keeps the complete online-proven V79 policy and makes the sale horizon opponent-aware. It uses the seven-turn lead only when both public farms have the same coordinate-level crop, structure, animal, farmer, hand, and land fingerprint with a small cash gap; otherwise it preserves V79's four-turn horizon. No hidden information, opponent identity, replay fingerprint, or production parameter is used. This is the lower-risk option designed to target same-lineage market races without always selling early.

Final holdout versus V79: 30 games, mean paired delta +38.20 coins, median 0, worst -4; 8 better, 20 equal, 2 worse. These are local cash margins against frozen public families, not a Kaggle rating prediction. A separate second seed panel was also used during selection.

Direct public ancestry: https://www.kaggle.com/code/guruprasaathas111/kaggriculture-top-2-master-engine-v4. Full attribution is retained in `main.py` and `NOTICE.txt` under Apache-2.0 terms.

Run both code cells to create `submission.tar.gz` with `main.py`, `LICENSE.txt`, and `NOTICE.txt` at archive root. Standard-library CPU only; no network or GPU is required. The notebook contains no tests, replay data, credentials, or automatic submission code.
